setup.stat_insight_viewed: You opened {rate}% of your {shown} notifications right away
setup.stat_insight_skipped: Stayed quiet {count} times — you were already looking

setup.codex_trust_title: Restart Codex and approve the hooks
setup.codex_trust_desc: Running Codex sessions keep the old hooks. Restart Codex and trust them on the Hooks need review screen to get Codex notifications.
setup.path_mismatch_desc: The saved path differs from the current executable path. Saving will update to the current path.
setup.not_saved_desc: These are default values. Click 'Save' below to register hooks in settings.json and activate them.

design.desc: Compose the notification toast design layer by layer. Applies from the next notification after saving.
design.effect_ring_desc: An event-colored tail orbits the border
design.effect_shimmer_desc: A sheen periodically sweeps the surface

general.auto_start_desc: Automatically launch the app when an agent session starts

hooks.desc: The same notification settings apply to every agent you turn on.
hooks.notice: Saving applies to Claude Code right away. Codex needs a restart, and after hooks are added or changed you must trust them on the review screen Codex shows at startup.
hooks.dynamic_message_desc: Show the last reply, the approval reason, or the question in the notification. Falls back to each notification's default text when there is nothing to show.
hooks.message_fallback_label: Default text (when the agent sends none)
hooks.stop_desc: Notify when the agent finishes its reply.
hooks.permission_request_desc: Notify when a command or action needs your approval. Claude's questions arrive here too.
hooks.question_desc: Notify when the agent asks a question and waits for your answer.
hooks.session_start_desc: When a session starts or resumes
hooks.user_prompt_submit_desc: When you send the agent a new message
hooks.subagent_stop_desc: When a subagent finishes its reply
hooks.pre_compact_desc: Right before the conversation is compacted
hooks.notification_permission_desc: While waiting for a permission approval
hooks.notification_elicitation_desc: When an MCP server asks for your input
hooks.notification_idle_desc: After waiting more than 60 seconds for input
hooks.interrupt_desc: When you stop a response in progress

about.description: Agent Toast is a Windows app that displays desktop notifications when events occur in Claude Code (or Codex CLI), such as task completion or user input required.
about.howto_desc: How to set up Agent Toast to receive Claude Code event notifications.
about.howto_step1_desc: Enable the events you want notifications for in the 'Hooks' tab.
about.howto_step2_desc: Click 'Save' to register hooks in the settings file.
about.howto_step3_desc: Claude Code sessions apply changes automatically after saving. Codex applies them after a restart, once you trust the hooks on its review screen.
about.star_message: If you find this useful, please give us a star on GitHub!
about.star_thanks: Thank you! Your star means a lot
about.update_manual: Auto-update is not available. Please download the latest version from GitHub.

remote.title: Remote Notifications
remote.disabled_hint: Enable the HTTP server to see the setup guide.

snippet.urlHint: Replace with an address the server can reach this desktop at. 0.0.0.0 is not externally reachable — use a Tailscale hostname/IP, LAN IP, etc. (For SSH -R tunneling, use http://localhost:port)
snippet.hostnameHint: Sender name shown in the notification. Leave empty to use the server's actual hostname. (e.g. "work server", "home server")
